utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll swing by the repair drive later and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, I’ll keep it simple and be ready when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, I’ll stop by after my errands and check in with you.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring a wrench set and a flashlight if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I’ve got both—I’ll bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, can you confirm the repair drive is actually happening today? I just want to be sure before I count on it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I haven’t seen a cancellation, so I think it’s still on today. But I’d double-check the timing before you rely on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still happening today, but I should double-check the time first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to help, but I’m a bit scattered today. Tell me what you need and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Oren — I could use a roll of duct tape, a Phillips screwdriver, and a box of zip ties if you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think I’ve got the screwdriver and zip ties somewhere, but I’m not sure about the tape. I’ll check my shed and bring what I can find.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it was mostly the loose fence, a couple of broken porch steps, and maybe that squeaky gate. I might be forgetting one thing, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the fence, porch steps, and squeaky gate. If you remember the missing thing, let me know before I start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Jules, I’m a little late—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries—good to see you. We’re still collecting donations and sorting tools; you just missed a quick update, but there’s plenty to jump in on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’m here now—what do you want me to tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a couple of screwdrivers? If you can help sort the donated parts too, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it — I’ll bring my drill and a couple screwdrivers, and I can help sort the donated parts too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll keep an eye on the repair drive location and let you know if it changes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate it. That’ll help me plan around the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already—people are really showing up with tools and supplies. If you’re thinking of helping, I’d say swing by early before the good stuff runs out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Nice, I’m glad to hear it’s filling up. I’ll come by early and bring what I can—maybe I’ll also pass the word along to a couple more neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be wonderful, Quinn—every extra set of hands helps. I’ll be there early too, so if you spot me, come say hi!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you decide what needs fixing for the drive, Rey?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still thinking it through, Mina. I’ll let you know what I’ve got once I’ve checked around a bit.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure, Rey—can you check the porch light and the loose fence while you’re at it?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m ready to help with the repair drive, and I’ll keep the plan moving along. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ve only heard bits and pieces, but I think we need hands, tools, and a clear list of what to tackle first. If you can help organize that, I can spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll put together a clear first-step list, and I’ll repeat the plan to a few neighbors so we can line up hands and tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any updates on supplies or helpers, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — I don’t have any updates yet, but I’ll let you know if I hear anything about supplies or helpers.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, thank you — I’ll keep the list moving and check back with you soon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming up soon — folks are pitching in all sorts of tools and supplies. I’ll keep an ear out for the exact details and let you know!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — I appreciate that. Just let me know the time and what to bring, and I’ll plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it — I’m still waiting on the exact time and list, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear. For now, just be ready to bring whatever tools you’ve got handy.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’m still lining up a few folks, and I’ll repeat the plan once I’ve got the final details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll wait for the final plan and jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive, but I’m still getting my bearings. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rey. If you can just help me sort the donations and keep track of who’s coming by, that would be a big relief.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and keep a list of who’s coming by. Just point me to where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in—just give me the quick version and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—first I’m checking the repair drive sign-in spot, then I’ll note which addresses still need a pickup. If you can cover one route, I’ll point you to the closest one.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—send me the closest route and I’ll take it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who want to pitch in. Want me to check who’s available?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please check who’s available. Could you also note whether they can help with setup, repairs, or cleanup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available and note whether they can help with setup, repairs, or cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. What’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mostly just the timing and a few supply needs. I can check the latest details and make sure we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara—please check the latest details and let me know what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest yet, but I can check around while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Ira — that’d be a big help. If you hear anything useful, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it — I’ll ask around while I’m out and tell you anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — could you help collect the donated tools and sort them by type?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can gather the donated tools and sort them by type.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to sort out the timing and who’s bringing what first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Fair enough—when are you free to meet, and what do you want me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m free Saturday morning, and it’d help if you could bring the tools list and any spare parts you already have.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to swing by and drop off an invite?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please swing by—I’d love an invite and I can check what supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll swing by soon with an invite and a quick supplies list too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to stay in the Faye role and reply with a short line. I’m checking the repair drive schedule around school pickup, and then I can coordinate from there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—thanks, Faye. I’ll check the repair drive schedule and keep it clear around school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—please keep me posted, and I’ll work around school pickup on my end.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted. Let’s start by listing the homes that need help most.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ve heard a couple folks mention loose steps and a leaky faucet, so I’ll pass those along if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That helps a lot, thank you, Nell — send me those names and I’ll add them to the list first. I’ll make sure we cover the most urgent fixes.
